request: Use /computer-use as the settings entry and make the internal on/off interaction native to pi rather than a one-shot picker.

files.packages/pi-codex-computer-use/src/comma: Canonical computer-use command. TUI custom settings view; RPC repeating dialogs; print/JSON status and explicit arguments. All changes share setFeature, preserving waitForIdle and updateState's persistence/restart flow.
files.packages/pi-codex-computer-use/src/setti: ComputerUseSettingsPanel built with pi DynamicBorder, SettingsList, Text, active theme and keybindings. Three tabs, in-place asynchronous saving/checks, feedback, input lock during pending operations, persisted value restoration after failed save, deferred close during pending operations.
files.scripts/check-package.mjs: Requires dist/settings-ui.js in the new package.
files.README and usage docs (en/ko): Describe /computer-use, native tabs/keys, immediate persistence, RPC fallback and unchanged settings directory. Prior runtime/approval limitations retained.

interaction.changeFeature: Enter / Space on Enabled cycles on/off
interaction.diagnostics: Status → Check setup, arrow keys select result rows and reveal details
interaction.close: Esc closes the screen without reverting saved changes; waits for an in-flight save/check rather than disposing its context mid-operation
interaction.save: wait for idle → persist the existing two-key schema → restart shared cua_repl → refresh registered tools and actual UI values
interaction.errors: Shown in the same screen; the optimistic SettingsList value is reset to the persisted state until saving finishes
interaction.width: Short tab labels on narrower terminals; active tab name/index when narrower than 35 columns; compact diagnostic labels with full selected-row details

modes.rpc: Repeating feature/status/check picker, then on/off choice; both flags can be edited within one invocation; Close/dismiss exits
modes.print: Bare command prints current status, explicit status/check/computer/browser arguments work
modes.json: Same no-UI command behavior; diagnostic text remains on stderr

tui.method: Actual pi 0.99.1 subprocess in a pseudo-terminal, isolated PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, offline mode, no model requests or app/browser operations
tui.regularDark: 80 columns × 32 rows: /computer-use opens; Enter turns Computer Use off; Tab+Space turns Browser Use off; MCP stops with both off; Shift+Tab+Enter turns Computer Use on; Esc closes; reopening retains the saved values; Status tab opens; pi exits 0
tui.fullscreenLightNarrow: 38 columns × 28 rows: same keyboard/persistence/close flow passed with light theme and fullscreen mode
tui.saveRecoveryAndDiagnostics: 38-column fullscreen/light: force save to fail by replacing the temporary settings path with a directory after startup; EISDIR shown in-place; removing the obstruction and retrying persists Computer off while retaining Browser on. Status Check setup completes in-place; result rows navigated with arrows; Esc and pi exit succeed
tui.cleanup: Only temporary verification agent directories used; each final successful pi run exited 0 and its package-owned MCP process closed. No user app was operated.
